description: Read response and resolution metrics, 90-day daily issue/message and timing trends, and weekday/hour incoming-message heatmaps in the company timezone. Missing timings stay unmeasured. fullyAutomatic counts original automatic-plan and routine-rule issue closures, including linked issues; earlier human help and pending run verification do not make the closure manual. closedWithoutPerson is the strict subset where no person approved or edited a plan, replied, finished a human task or changed the case on the issue or a linked issue before it closed. automationByCategory and automationByChannel break resolved, fullyAutomatic and closedWithoutPerson down by case category and channel; daily trends include both closure counts.
